answer: A beacon-decay bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity tends a river beacon, locks 70 credits, and files a signed jade reading with fresh yarrow each epoch. An auditor replays the river table: missing, reused, or faded readings decay the bond 10% an epoch to burnout. First 36, kth 36+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. One key, five posts, exposes a rented-beacon ring. An honest keeper files once, pays 36, keeps it.
